Name: Seasonal Nyapu Sebastian Edits (Older and Shorter-Haired)
Author: spiriituals
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
I edited and color altered some portraits provided by @Nyapu and @AhCuteArt-- none of this is my art, only some small edits to give Sebastian an appearance pour moi taste. (Figured I'd share them here since I had them lol)
[i]--Gave him some scruff (stubble), more piercings, shortened his hair, and some additional edits to give that older look[/i]

These were originally made for personal use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31574]Kantrip's Older Sebastian - Character Expansion[/url] mod by Kantrip!
^^highly recommend this expansion mod if you're going to use these portraits, they goes well with it :)

[size=5][b]DETAILS:[/b][/size]
[size=4][u][i]REPALCERS!![/i][/u][/size]
[i]Downloads include portraits AND sprite edits.[/i]

There are two options: a beach portrait similar to vanilla where Seb wears a shirt, and a version where he doesn't (I will not be shamed).

In whatever download you choose, I have included three folder paths:
- the files that will replace the Seb portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=files]Nyapu's Portraits[/url] by Nyapu
- the files that will replace the Seb portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] by Poltergeister
- the files that will replace the Seb portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255?tab=files]SEASONAL SDV OUTFIT NYAPU STYLE RETEXTURES[/url] by AhCuteArt
Use whatever you need.

Hopefully this isn't too confusing. Unfortunately, I do not know code so making a CP version to simplify install is not available....


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip the download file "ShirtSeb" or "NoShirtSeb" and then drag the whatever folders you need into your already existing "mods" folder. When you are prompted to replace files of the same name-- do so.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Again, it depends on what you're using, but you likely need the one or all of these mods:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=files]Nyapu's Portraits[/url][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=files]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255?tab=files]SEASONAL SDV OUTFIT NYAPU STYLE RETEXTURES[/url]
^^My uploads are for replacing files in the CP versions of these mods^^
